offering_description.value: NetApp sells data storage systems and software to businesses and government agencies. It develops the software that runs its storage systems and delivers cloud storage and data management through its own software and services offered with major cloud providers.

primary_products.value: all-flash storage arrays; hybrid flash and disk storage arrays; storage operating software; cloud storage and data management software

primary_services.value: managed cloud file storage; cloud backup and disaster recovery; paid technical support; storage deployment and migration consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Enterprise IT departments, midsize businesses, and cloud and managed service providers; B2G: Defense and civilian government agencies

end_markets.value: enterprise data centers; cloud computing; financial services; healthcare; government and defense

revenue_model.value: product sales: Enterprise storage systems, upgrades, and replacement components; service fees: Paid maintenance, technical support, deployment, and migration; subscription: Term access to cloud storage and data management software; transaction or usage fees: Metered cloud storage capacity and consumption-based on-premises storage; licensing or royalties: Licenses for storage and data management software
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; subscription; transaction or usage fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Combines sourced hardware with proprietary software in storage systems sold to enterprises and agencies; software / platform: Builds storage and data management software for enterprise IT teams and cloud providers; service provider: Uses its storage software and cloud infrastructure to deliver managed storage and data protection to organizations
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: On-premises storage systems, cloud storage, data management and protection software, and related services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: NetApp account teams serving large enterprises and public agencies; distributors / dealers: IT distributors that supply storage systems to local and regional resellers; partners / resellers: Value-added resellers, systems integrators, managed service providers, and cloud providers; online: Cloud marketplaces and provider consoles for software and managed storage
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Encryption and storage exports face U.S. export controls, and cloud services are subject to data privacy rules.
